name: TIDAL
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For TIDAL, stream a personal lossless music library from user-owned storage. The hard boundary is licensed catalog, artist relationships, high-resolution delivery, recommendations, and apps, plus licensed content, rights, and distribution network.
